description: This file contains unit tests for the 'suitesService' module using Jest testing framework. It mocks external dependencies such as environment variables and network fetch calls, and verifies the behavior of the 'list' method of the service.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by resetting modules, mocking fetch, and requiring the service under test.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Restores all mocks after each test.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case verifying that the 'list' method returns an array of suites with expected properties.
